items.title: Hearing to consider that the issuance of a Type-42 on-sale beer and wine liquor license to MCELENEY, FEARGHAL doing business as Bark 77, located at 77 Cambon Drive (District 7), will serve the public convenience or necessity of the City and County of San Francisco.

Hearing on the rise of rental scams targeting prospective tenants and property owners in San Francisco, including fraudulent listings, fake landlords, unauthorized subletting schemes, and unauthorized use of legitimate listings; and requesting the Police Department, District Attorney's Office, Rent Board, Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development, Department of Homelessness and Supportive Housing, and Office of the Treasurer and Tax Collector to report.
Hearing on the City's enforcement efforts on illegal dumping; and requesting the Department of Public Works to report.

Ordinance amending the Health Code to reduce the time an animal impounded in the City animal shelter operated by the Animal Care and Control Department (ACC) must be held before being deemed abandoned; reduce the time before an animal is deemed abandoned by its owner after being delivered to ACC because the owner is unable to care for it; modify the rules concerning mandatory sterilization of pit bulls; require a person who wishes to breed dogs in the City to obtain a permit from ACC and setting the permit fee at $200; allow ACC to sterilize all dogs impounded in the City animal shelter, subject to certain exceptions; and to require ACC to report certain information concerning the impact of these amendments to the Board of Supervisors and the Mayor.

General Public Comment Informational Members of the public may address the Commission(s) on topics that are within the subject matter of the Commission(s) but are not part of this agenda. Comments specific to an item on the agenda may be heard when that item is considered. Members of the public may address the Commission for up to three minutes. General Public Comment may be continued to the end of the agenda if speakers exceed 15 minutes of General Public Comment.

Consent Calendar of Routine Matters All items listed on the consent calendar are considered routine by the Commission and may be acted upon together by a single vote of the Commission. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a member of the Commission, the public or staff requests individual consideration. In that case, the item will be removed from the consent calendar and considered individually at this or a future hearing.

1660 Mission Health Recovery and Connection Center Project, Contract No. 1000039076 – Contract Modification Action • Staff Recommendation: Approve modification of Contract No. 1000039076 - 1660 Mission Health Recovery and Connection Center with Charles Pankow Builders, to award the design and construction phases of the contract and increase the contract value by $59,908,630 for a new not-to-exceed amount of $60,766,900 and a total contract duration of 820 consecutive calendar days. On October 22, 2026, the Planning Department determined that the work to be performed under the contract is exempt from CEQA as a Class 32 categorical exemption (CEQA Guidelines Section 15332) as described in the determination contained in the Commission's files for this contract.
